title.narrative: 2.5 Number of women and men who have secure tenure of land with EU support

description.narrative: 2.5 Number of women and men who have secure tenure of land with EU support(EURF 8, level2)

comment.narrative: It was not possible to collect the baseline for this indicator because the issue of land registration in Mozambique is a major problem. The entities responsible for land administration at central provincial or district level have difficulty in collecting this information especially the data disaggregated by gender. The analysis conducted for the review of the National Land Policy also confirmed this problem and therefore this was one of the issues that was addressed by the current Policy approved last year.
